audit_items.proof_trace: FlashLoan (market.move L39-42) and ReserveFlashLoan (reserve.move L33-35) both have no `has` clause, so the Move VM denies drop unconditionally — any tx that fails to consume the hot potato is aborted at the bytecode level. The only production consumers are repay_flash_loan variants, which destructure the struct and assert full repayment (principal + fee) before returning.
